content_text:
Hello everyone,
Tomorrow, on the Team Deakins Youtube channel, we’ll be publishing a video recording of the Deakins’ second night in Atlanta. This video features a conversation between the Deakins and Millie de Chirico in front of a live audience before a screening of JESSE JAMES. The video was generously shared with us by the event organizers.
We hope you enjoy it!
